title: Evidence Cycle 001 closes both Wave 60B source checks
summary: DARPA's official Lift Challenge results close the measured-performance and prize-decision gate, while the current FAA Shuttle Landing Facility surfaces still provide no later formal licence disposition. The two decisions retain separate receipts, identities, boundaries, and next actions.
evidence_note: The DARPA decision is limited to the official measured competition result and prizes. The FAA decision is limited to the official pages and licence document reviewed on August 23; it does not establish lapse, renewal, surrender, closure, or nonexistence. Neither receipt establishes operating outcomes.
publication_effect: Publishes two independently reviewed receipts, promotes the DARPA result signal to the exact measured-result stage, retains the Shuttle Landing Facility signal In Review, and advances no named-file stage or operating outcome.
